# Third-party notices

The release includes Eclipse JDT Language Server and Eclipse components (EPL-2.0 and component notices), JUnit Platform Console Standalone (EPL-2.0), JaCoCo (EPL-2.0), and npm dependencies recorded in the CycloneDX SBOM. Complete license files distributed by the bundled runtime archives are retained in each runtime directory. JavaScript dependency licenses are generated from the package lock during release CI. The external Node.js runtime and JDK are supplied by the user and are not distributed with java-lsp-mcp.

Primary application dependencies: `@modelcontextprotocol/server` (MIT), `chokidar` (MIT), `diff` (BSD-3-Clause), `vscode-jsonrpc` (MIT), and `zod` (MIT).
